newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ICTSI expects sharp rise in 1997 net.
newsitem.headline: ICTSI expects sharp rise in 1997 net.

text.p: International Container Terminal Services Inc (ICTSI) said on Thursday it expects net income this year to jump 22 percent from 1996 levels.
"We are expecting a 22 percent increase in net income this year," chairman of ICTSI Enrique Razon told shareholders.
The company's net income in 1996 was 474.74 million pesos.
He also also predicted revenue would rise 28 percent from last year's 2.5 billion pesos.
He said most of the company's overseas units were now in operation while prospects were for an increase in cargo along with the improvement in the Philippines economy.
Razon declined to give first quarter income but said figures for March were high after the normal slow start to the year in the first two months.
Capital expenditure for this year will be $66 million, of which half will be used for the expansion of its international container terminal in Manila.
Other spending will be on its joint-venture in Karachi, the construction of a grain terminal in Manila and an international container terminal outside the Philippine capital.
